shower.thought: We spend the first part of our lives wishing we were older and the second part wishing we were younger, but we're never satisfied with the exact age we are right now.
The people who claim they don't care what others think are usually the ones most carefully curating that image.
You'll never know if you made the right choice because you'll never get to see what would have happened if you chose differently.
Nostalgia is just your brain selling you a lie about your past with a better marketing team.
The more you learn about how things work, the less magical the world becomes—but the more magical your understanding of it gets.
Everyone's life looks like a highlight reel to someone else and a blooper reel to themselves.
You can be completely honest with someone and still be completely misunderstood.
The moment you become aware of your own breathing is the moment you can't stop noticing it.
Most people aren't afraid of dying; they're afraid of dying without mattering to anyone.
You treat strangers with more courtesy than people you love, which is backwards if you think about it.
The only time you truly have someone's full attention is when they want something from you or you want something from them.
Your childhood trauma becomes your personality trait and you don't realize you're living in the past until someone points it out.
We fear abandonment so much that we'll abandon ourselves first.
The best conversations you'll ever have are with people you'll probably never talk to again.
Success is just failure you haven't quit yet, but so is stubbornness.
You don't actually miss people as much as you miss how they made you feel about yourself.
Confidence is just carefully managed delusion.
The reason we ask "how are you?" as a greeting instead of actually wanting to know is because we've collectively agreed that honesty would be too expensive.
Most of your embarrassing moments exist in vivid detail only in your own mind.
You can't step in the same river twice, but you keep trying to go back to the same person.

motivational.thought: The only permission you need is the permission you give yourself. — Unknown
Progress is a series of small rebellions against your former self. — Unknown
Your obstacles are not detours from your path—they are the path. — Unknown
Discipline is remembering what you want more than what you want right now. — Unknown
The difference between who you are and who you want to be is what you do. — Bill Phillips
Everything worthwhile is awkward at first. — Unknown
You don't rise to the level of your goals; you fall to the level of your systems. — James Clear
Regret for things we did can be tempered by time; it is regret for the things we did not do that is inconsolable. — Sydney Smith
The person you become tomorrow is shaped by the choices you make today. — Unknown
Small daily improvements over time lead to stunning results. — Robin Sharma
Your potential is not determined by your past; it's determined by your willingness to grow. — Unknown
Success is not final, failure is not fatal. What matters is the courage to continue. — Winston Churchill
The quieter you become, the more you can hear what needs to be done. — Unknown
You cannot talk yourself out of a problem you behaved yourself into. — Stephen Covey
Freedom is not the absence of struggle; it's the presence of choice. — Unknown
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now. — Chinese Proverb
What lies behind you and what lies before you pale in comparison to what lies within you. — Ralph Waldo Emerson
Waiting for perfect conditions to begin is just another word for procrastination. — Unknown
The gap between knowing and doing is where life actually happens. — Unknown
Your biggest breakthrough will come from your smallest consistent action. — Unknown

darkjoke.thought:
I told my therapist I had suicidal thoughts.
He said that would be $200. Suddenly I had a reason to live.

My grandfather said, "Your generation is too reliant on technology."
I said, "You're right," and unplugged his life support.

I'm reading a book on the history of glue.
I can't put it down.

My friend asked if I believed in capital punishment.
I said, "Only for my student loans."

I went to a gender reveal party last weekend.
It was a boy. His parents seemed less excited after the paternity test.

They say money can't buy happiness.
But it can buy a jetski. Have you ever seen someone frown on a jetski?
You have? That's probably because he just saw the gas prices.

I told my date I work in pharmaceutical sales.
She seemed interested until I mentioned my territory is retirement homes.

My therapist asked what my biggest fear was.
I said, "Abandonment."
She said, "Same time next week?"

I tried to make a belt out of herbs once.
It was a waist of thyme. But at the funeral, everyone said it really brought out the casket.

My friend's been in a coma for three months.
I keep visiting him to tell him jokes.
His wife asked why I bother since he can't hear me.
I said, "Well, someone has to enjoy them."

I asked my doctor if I'd live a long life.
He said, "Not the way you're going."
I said, "So I should make some changes?"
He said, "No, I mean not medically—you'll probably get hit by a bus."

My dad always said I'd never amount to anything.
He was right. I'm only worth about $47,000 in life insurance.
Mom's really cashed in on his parenting.

I joined a suicide prevention hotline.
Turns out I'm not very good at talking people down.
Mostly I'm just asking them what took so long.

My girlfriend left me because I'm too pessimistic.
Honestly, I saw it coming.

I started a support group for people who talk too much.
Ironically, everyone just left.
I'm still talking about it.

They found my grandfather dead this morning.
At least he went doing what he loved: disappointing the family.

I told my son that life isn't fair.
He said, "That's why you're still here."

My friend asked me to help him move.
I said I couldn't.
He said, "Why not?"
I said, "Because you're still alive."

I took up meditation to find inner peace.
Turns out I'm just really good at ignoring my problems.
Which, legally, counts as mindfulness now.

My wife asked if I'd ever cheat on her.
I said, "Only with death."
She said, "We'll see."
